## Draft: existing engine semantic preview
Import as a new, inactive workflow. This does not edit existing workflows or the separate V2.0 project.

1. Deploy the reviewed draft preview backend first.
2. Set renderer_base_url and your existing OpenAI model ID in Configure Preview.
3. Choose your existing OpenAI credential on OpenAI Plan Scene.
4. Choose an HTTP Header Auth credential on the three renderer HTTP nodes: Authorization = Bearer <RENDER_TOKEN>. Keep the secret in credentials.
5. Run manually. Validation errors stop the workflow before rendering.

Voice generation, word alignment, creative approval, Drive/Sheets logging and automatic intake are pending. No messages are sent.
